title: Bring the manager's worker panes back after a restart
notes: Follow-up from #155 (manager terminals). The manager's worker panes (manager-terminal-<n>) do not come back after the app restarts: session-store keys saved pages by project path, and the manager is not in that list. Project pages already restore their panes and resume their Claude sessions; the manager's should too.

comments.body: From #299 (#187): after a restart, the workers popup lists a restored worker under nobody, though session.json keeps its dispatcher (dispatcherOf in session-requests.ts). Fix that here too, since this card restores the workers. Builds on #299; start after it merges.
